3. Comprehensive germline bone‑marrow‑failure gene panel (includes SBDS, FAN family, ADA, others) to assess for inherited marrow‑failure syndromes.
4. Myeloid somatic NGS panel (targeted sequencing for MDS/leukemia genes) to detect clonal mutations supportive of hypoplastic MDS.
5. Repeat review of marrow histology by an experienced pediatric hematopathologist (if not already) to confirm hypocellularity vs focal cellularity and to re‑evaluate for subtle dysplasia or increased blasts.

8. Basic metabolic/hemolysis and nutritional workup: reticulocyte production index, LDH, bilirubin, haptoglobin, Coombs, B12/folate, iron studies (if not already).
9. 11.
